svg.title: Exact coarse-graining collision
svg.desc: What this figure shows: A many-to-one map can collapse maximally distinct point-mass laws to an identical coarse law. The plotted object is generated from C(x)=C(x'), x!=x' => C#delta_x = C#delta_x'. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Exact Proposition 17 counterexample. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
